If you're interested, I'd set up a 30-minute call with me and then a conversation with the hiring manager, Lena Ostrova. No cost or prep needed for the first call. Thanks!
note: Hard negative: an unsolicited recruiter message with salary, a named company and hiring manager and a normal process; contrasts with r3-scam-023.

INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR AGREEMENT (Marketing Services)

1. Services. Contractor will provide social media content and campaign reporting as described in Schedule A.
2. Fees. Company will pay Contractor $45.00 per hour, invoiced monthly, payable net 30.

text:
INDEPENDENT CONSULTANT AGREEMENT - Summary of Key Terms

This is not an offer of employment. As a Consultant you run your own small business selling Saltmere Candle products to customers.

- Starter kit: optional, $0 (digital) or $99 (samples), sold at our cost.
- No minimum monthly purchase is required to stay active or to earn commissions on your retail sales.
- We buy back unsold, resalable inventory at 90% of what you paid, within 12 months.
- Income Disclosure: in the last calendar year, the median annual earnings of all Consultants, including inactive ones, were $312. Most Consultants earn little or nothing.

Please read the full Income Disclosure Statement before you sign.
note: A lawful direct-selling agreement with the safeguards the Competition Bureau and FTC describe (kit at cost, no purchase quota, buyback, typical-earnings disclosure). Ambiguous: pay-to-join MLM that never claims to be a job; labeled legit because it discloses honestly and asks for no purchase to earn.

text:
Online Math Tutors (freelance)

Teach students one-on-one through our platform. You set your own hourly rate (most tutors charge $30-$60) and your own schedule. We keep a 18% platform commission on each paid lesson; you keep the rest, paid out every two weeks.

There is no sign-up fee, subscription or required training purchase. You're an independent contractor and will receive a 1099-NEC if you earn over the reporting threshold.

text:
Independent Life & Health Insurance Agent - Commission Only
Remote (licensed states: GA, SC, NC)

Please read carefully: this is a 1099 independent contractor role with no salary. You're paid commission by the insurance carriers on the policies you write.

Your costs: your state licence (roughly $150 for the exam and application) and errors & omissions insurance (about $40/month). You do not pay us anything. You are never required to recruit other agents, and you do not earn anything from other agents' sales.

We provide: carrier contracts, warm leads at no charge, and weekly training.
note: Legit commission-only insurance role with costs borne by the agent, all disclosed and with no recruiting income. Ambiguous: candidate-paid licensing and E&O plus 'commission only' and 'remote' overlap the scam set.
